title: Magnetic domain orientation in magnetite Fe3O4 nanoparticles coated with natural extracts from Syzygium aromaticum, Illicium verum or Lippia graveolens
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,17196-17206
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08815A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Nidia Esther Moreno-Cabrera, Mauricio D. Carbajal-Tinoco, J. Santoyo-Salazar
Direct polyphenol attachment on the surfaces of Fe3O4 nanoparticles <10 nm was done with extracts of S. aromaticum, I. verum, or L. graveolens. These exhibited effective superparamagnetic uniaxial magnetic response, plus phenol bonding Fe–OH action.
